Question 3
?

Consider the function y=f(x) whose graph is shown above. What are the x-coordinates of all the stationary points?

a
x=−2 and x=2 only
b
All points in the open interval (−2,2)
c
All points in the closed interval [−2,2]
d
All points in the intervals (−5,−2) and (2,5)
e
All points in the closed intervals (−5,−2] and [2,5)
